name: simoptix_overlays
description: A G-meter overlay that reads Le Mans Ultimate's telemetry.
long_description: SimOptix: Overlays adds the SimOptix: G-Meter Overlay source. It shows the car's G-forces from LMU's telemetry, in step with SimOptix: VR Mirror's view. It also works over a normal capture of a flat-screen game, and plays a demo lap without the game.
